item.title: Right-wing media are bitterly divided over potential war with Iran
item.description: The Trump administration has amassed military forces near Iran, causing tension in right-wing media over the possibility of another war in the Middle East. While some have voiced a full-throated defense of the use of military intimidation to pursue regime change in Iran, others have said a war with Iran would be a “betrayal” to the MAGA movement.
